name: exchekskills
description: ExChek for SMB manufacturers — 20 export-compliance skills + two regulatory-data MCP servers (a local-first one and the hosted ExChek API). Classify ECCNs, screen parties, check licenses, track rule changes, run audits, and produce audit-ready Word reports without hiring a consultant. Free edition is complete on its own; the Enterprise edition adds official PDF memoranda and a live compliance dashboard (continuous screening, products registry, regulatory radar). Works in Cowork and Claude Code.

platform_tier.title: AI platform tier
platform_tier.description: Your privacy/training tier. ExChek records this in every audit-ready report. Recommended: Cowork enterprise, Claude Enterprise, Claude Team, or a Workspace with training disabled.

regulatory_source.title: Regulatory data source
regulatory_source.description: Where skills pull live CFR text. 'ask' (default) = a one-time gate lets you choose per session; 'api' = ExChek API MCP (api.exchek.us, Cloudflare edge cache — fastest, no local Node/ecfr.gov dependency); 'local' = local MCP, direct from www.ecfr.gov and cached on your machine. Only CFR part numbers and search terms ever transit the API — never your item descriptions, party names, or compliance results. Screening, sanitization, audit logging, and report generation always stay local regardless of this setting. In Claude Cowork (browser), the local Node MCP can't spawn — choose 'api'; the local-only tools (CSL screening, audit log, Word .docx export) require Claude Code or a desktop runtime.

trade_gov_api_key.title: Trade.gov API key (free)
trade_gov_api_key.description: Free key from https://developer.trade.gov. Required only when you screen parties (CSL search). Stored in your OS keychain — never in plain text. Get one in 2 minutes if you don't have it; the screening tool will tell you when you need it.

audit_key.title: Audit-log HMAC key (optional)
audit_key.description: Lets you bring your own 32+ character key to seal the local audit log. If you skip this, the plugin generates one on first run and stores it owner-readable in the plugin data directory.

default_report_dir.title: Default report folder
default_report_dir.description: Where finished .docx reports land. Defaults to ~/Documents/ExChek-Reports. You can always override per-report.

enterprise_api_key.title: ExChek Enterprise API key (optional)
enterprise_api_key.description: Unlocks the official branded classification-memorandum PDF ($1 per report, prepaid credits). Sign in and buy credits at https://app.exchek.us — the key (exk_live_…) is shown once after purchase, or skip keys entirely with the OAuth connector (https://api.exchek.us/mcp/pro) on claude.ai/Claude Desktop. Leave empty to use only the free features; analysis, regulatory data, and the free Word report never require a key.

edition.title: Edition (free or enterprise)
edition.description: Which ExChek edition the skills should assume. 'ask' (default) = the setup skill asks once and records your answer; 'free' = skills never raise Enterprise features beyond a single one-line wrap-up mention (and you can turn even that off by telling the agent); 'enterprise' = skills default to offering the official PDF memorandum and dashboard sync. Analysis is identical in both editions — Enterprise adds deliverables and the live dashboard, never better answers.

transaction_sync.title: Dashboard transaction sync
transaction_sync.description: Mirror compliance-pipeline STATUS to your app.exchek.us dashboard (Enterprise; requires enterprise_api_key or an OAuth connector). Records stage/status/short refs only — e.g. "classify ✓ EAR99" — never item details, party names, or document content, and never anything from a CUI/classified engagement. 'ask' (default) = consent question once per run; 'on' = always; 'off' = never.
